registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.min_vertices_le_of_exchange
registry.statement:
∀ (f : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (a₀ b₀ S : ℤ),
  (∀ (a b : ℤ), a₀ < a → b₀ < b → a + b = S → f (a + 1) (b - 1) + f (a - 1) (b + 1) ≤ 2 * f a b) →
    ∀ (a b : ℤ), a₀ ≤ a → b₀ ≤ b → a + b = S → min (f a₀ (S - a₀)) (f (S - b₀) b₀) ≤ f a b

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.vertex_principle_discrete
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (f : (ι → ℤ) → ℝ) (lam : ι → ℤ) (S : ℤ),
  ∑ j, lam j < S →
    (∀ (c : ι → ℤ) (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∀ (j : ι), lam j ≤ c j) →
            ∑ j, c j = S →
              lam i < c i →
                lam k < c k → f (c + Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single k 1) + f (c + Pi.single k 1 - Pi.single i 1) ≤ 2 * f c) →
      ∀ (c : ι → ℤ), (∀ (j : ι), lam j ≤ c j) → ∑ j, c j = S → ∃ p, f (lam + Pi.single p (S - ∑ j, lam j)) ≤ f c

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.vertex_principle_discrete_min
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Nonempty ι] (f : (ι → ℤ) → ℝ) (lam : ι → ℤ)
  (S : ℤ),
  ∑ j, lam j < S →
    (∀ (c : ι → ℤ) (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∀ (j : ι), lam j ≤ c j) →
            ∑ j, c j = S →
              lam i < c i →
                lam k < c k → f (c + Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single k 1) + f (c + Pi.single k 1 - Pi.single i 1) ≤ 2 * f c) →
      ∀ (c : ι → ℤ),
        (∀ (j : ι), lam j ≤ c j) →
          ∑ j, c j = S → (Finset.univ.inf' ⋯ fun p => f (lam + Pi.single p (S - ∑ j, lam j))) ≤ f c

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.sum_sq_identity
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (a : ι → Polynomial ℝ) (a' : κ → Polynomial ℝ)
  (δ : ι → ℕ) (δ' : κ → ℕ),
  (∑ v, a v) * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) ^ 2 * a' w + (∑ w, a' w) * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) ^ 2 * a v -
      (2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) * a v) * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) * a' w =
    ∑ v, ∑ w, (↑(δ v) - ↑(δ' w)) ^ 2 * a v * a' w

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.two_planted_identity
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (a : ι → Polynomial ℝ) (a' : κ → Polynomial ℝ)
  (δ : ι → ℕ) (δ' : κ → ℕ) (Ψ Ψ' Q Q' : Polynomial ℝ),
  Polynomial.X *
        ((Ψ + Polynomial.X * ∑ v, a v) * (Q' + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) ^ 2 * a' w) +
          (Ψ' + Polynomial.X * ∑ w, a' w) * (Q + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) ^ 2 * a v)) -
      2 * (Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) * a v) * (Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) * a' w) =
    Polynomial.X *
          (Ψ * (Q' + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) ^ 2 * a' w) +
            Ψ' * (Q + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) ^ 2 * a v)) +
        Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ((∑ v, a v) * Q' + (∑ w, a' w) * Q) +
      Polynomial.X ^ 4 * ∑ v, ∑ w, (↑(δ v) - ↑(δ' w)) ^ 2 * a v * a' w

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.two_planted_mem
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] {b1 b2 : ℕ} {a : ι → Polynomial ℝ}
  {a' : κ → Polynomial ℝ} (δ : ι → ℕ) (δ' : κ → ℕ) {Ψ Ψ' R1 R1' H H' Q Q' : Polynomial ℝ},
  Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 1) Ψ →
    Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 1) Ψ' →
      Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 3) R1 →
        Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 3) R1' →
          Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b1 H →
            Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b2 H' →
              Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 2) Q →
                Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 2) Q' →
                  (∀ (v : ι), Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b1 (a v)) →
                    (∀ (w : κ), Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b2 (a' w)) →
                      Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + b2 + 6)
                        (Polynomial.X * (Ψ * R1' + Ψ' * R1) + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * (H * Q' + H' * Q) +
                          Polynomial.X ^ 4 * ∑ v, ∑ w, (↑(δ v) - ↑(δ' w)) ^ 2 * a v * a' w)

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.two_planted_lhs_mem
registry.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] {b1 b2 : ℕ} {a : ι → Polynomial ℝ}
  {a' : κ → Polynomial ℝ} (δ : ι → ℕ) (δ' : κ → ℕ) {Ψ Ψ' Q Q' : Polynomial ℝ},
  Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 1) Ψ →
    Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 1) Ψ' →
      Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 3) (Q + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) ^ 2 * a v) →
        Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 3) (Q' + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) ^ 2 * a' w) →
          Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + 2) Q →
            Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b2 + 2) Q' →
              (∀ (v : ι), Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b1 (a v)) →
                (∀ (w : κ), Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone b2 (a' w)) →
                  Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.WienerCone (b1 + b2 + 6)
                    (Polynomial.X *
                        ((Ψ + Polynomial.X * ∑ v, a v) * (Q' + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) ^ 2 * a' w) +
                          (Ψ' + Polynomial.X * ∑ w, a' w) * (Q + Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) ^ 2 * a v)) -
                      2 * (Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ v, ↑(δ v) * a v) * (Polynomial.X ^ 2 * ∑ w, ↑(δ' w) * a' w))

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD_succ_lt
registry.statement:
∀ (q : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
  2 ≤ N →
    (∀ j ≤ N, 0 < q j) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ), j + 2 ≤ N → q j * q (j + 2) < q (j + 1) ^ 2) →
        0 < α →
          q (N - 1) = α * q N →
            ∀ (k : ℕ),
              k + 2 ≤ N →
                q (k + 1) < q k →
                  ∀ (j : ℕ),
                    k ≤ j →
                      j + 2 ≤ N →
                        Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD α q (j + 1) <
                          Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD α q j

registry.name: Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD_maxIndex_le
registry.statement:
∀ (q : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
  2 ≤ N →
    (∀ j ≤ N, 0 < q j) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ), j + 2 ≤ N → q j * q (j + 2) < q (j + 1) ^ 2) →
        0 < α →
          q (N - 1) = α * q N →
            ∀ (k : ℕ),
              k + 2 ≤ N →
                q (k + 1) < q k →
                  ∀ (p : ℕ),
                    p + 1 ≤ N →
                      (∀ (j : ℕ),
                          j + 1 ≤ N →
                            Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD α q j ≤
                              Conjectura.Research.CollinsShorPeak.upperD α q p) →
                        p ≤ k
